description.value: The Terminal Bar is a historic Nanaimo institution on Victoria Crescent, established in 1912 and now over a century old. It sits in the heart of Nanaimo's heritage downtown, just steps from the harbourfront. Touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo will find it a characterful stop in a neighbourhood rich with history.
